condition: Source/host review and explicit runner handoff required before launch; each run must pass the frozen full-byte/canary/callback analyzer before advancing.
primary_observations: Native NtReadFile entry-to-return mean by request size and weighted over all operations
450 us verified reads/s at both 783 and 900 free pages
reporting: Each candidate versus its immediately preceding control; report all eight cases, including 250 us regressions. No other runner job interleaves the sequence.
acceptance_scope: Repeatable measured gain with all full oracles passing and no unexplained regression exceeding 20 percent; code shape alone is insufficient.
limits: two observations per variant are not statistical significance
shared private state is reseeded only for the generated fixture file
synthetic blocking frame cadence and deadlines
